summary: A model is a directory with meta.json and one JSON file per element under kind-specific directories. Coverage ledgers record reviewed tracked paths for a full Git commit.
transport: Repository filesystem under .feynman/model/; element and ledger files are UTF-8 JSON.
framing: One JSON object per file; ids are kebab-case filenames and are not duplicated inside elements. Collections load sorted by id.

messages.name: model element
messages.summary: Metadata and typed actor/flow/protocol/state/invariant/claim/limit properties, validated against kind-specific schemas.

fields.name: id
fields.note: Element identity is encoded in its path, not body.

messages.name: coverage ledger
messages.summary: Commit-scoped review evidence used to compute coverage.

fields.name: files
fields.note: Each entry has path, outcome and optional note; directory entries only for vendored/generated.
